name: powershell-lsp
description: PowerShell language server (PowerShellEditorServices) for Claude Code's LSP tool. Adds goToDefinition, hover, findReferences, and documentSymbol for .ps1/.psm1/.psd1 files. Uses a stdio-to-named-pipe proxy because PowerShell's I/O wrapping breaks PSES under raw stdio on Windows. Auto-downloads PowerShellEditorServices from GitHub releases on first launch and caches it under the user's local app data.
